title: Unit 27 Consolidation: Disease, Prevention and Medical Ethics
goal: I can use the words for disease, prevention, dogma and medical ethics.
I can name a cause, describe a measure with a participle, set evidence against a belief and state a duty of the doctor.
I can say how big a change was and say what the text about Semmelweis Ignác tells.
